name: karabiner-elements
description: Manage Karabiner-Elements keyboard remaps, complex modifications, profiles, and macOS keyboard automation config.

interface.longDescription: Use Karabiner Elements to inspect and update local keyboard remapping configuration. The skill treats Karabiner config as live machine state: inspect active profiles/devices first, show the intended JSON change or diff, back up edited files, require confirmation before writes or profile/service changes, lint when possible, and document rollback.
defaultPrompt: Use karabiner-elements to add this keyboard remap
Review my Karabiner config for conflicts
Help create a Karabiner complex modification
